warnings: B12 section prints '4 DB 12 mm.' twice (one leader to the upper bars, one to the lower bars) while six bar dots are drawn (two top, two mid-depth, two bottom). Recorded as printed, top 4 / bottom 4, flagged — the alternative (the two callouts overlapping at the mid row, 6 bars in all) is plausible.

B12 carries an RC eave flange (0.20 + 0.20 wide, 0.08 thick) with its own '3 DB 12 mm.' and 'ป RB 6 mm. @ 0.15 m.' — kept in additional_bars / note, not merged into the beam faces. The steel channel 'เหล็ก USE 1 - ⊏ - 150x75x75x4mm.' fixed to the side of B12 is noted on the element.
B7 is drawn here only as the 0.50-deep support of the ridge connection; its spec is on S-11.
